newsitem.title: UK: N.Irish police find bomb parts in north Belfast.
newsitem.headline: N.Irish police find bomb parts in north Belfast.

text.p: Northern Ireland security forces found explosives and other bomb parts in a derelict house in a pro-British Protestant area of north Belfast on Tuesday, police said.

The discovery, which security sources linked to banned pro-British Loyalists, comes at a time of heightened tension between Protestant extremists and Catholic republican guerrillas fighting to end British rule in the province.
"An army technical officer recovered a holdall containing parts of an explosive device which included a quantity of home made explosives and a detonator," a police spokesman said.
The Irish Republican Army has in recent months launched a wave of attacks on security forces in a bid to end rule from London.
Loyalist extremists were blamed for a failed bomb attack earlier this month near offices of the IRA's political arm in Monaghan town in the Irish Republic.
